title: CAN YOU
GET
5 OUT OF 5?
hook: Five geography questions. Three seconds each. Most people miss number five!

qs.q: What is the capital of Australia?
qs.fact: Canberra was built to settle the rivalry between Sydney and Melbourne.
qs.sayAnswer: Canberra! It was built to settle the rivalry between Sydney and Melbourne.

qs.q: Which is the smallest country in the world?
qs.fact: Vatican City covers less than half a square kilometer.
qs.sayAnswer: Vatican City! It covers less than half a square kilometer.

qs.q: Which is the largest desert on Earth?
qs.fact: A desert is defined by low rainfall, and Antarctica is the driest continent.
qs.sayAnswer: Antarctica! A desert just means very little rain, and it is the driest continent.

qs.q: Which country has the most time zones?
qs.fact: France has 12, thanks to its overseas territories. Russia has 11.
qs.sayAnswer: France! It has twelve, thanks to its overseas territories. Russia has eleven.

qs.q: Which country has the most islands?
qs.fact: Sweden has more than 260,000 islands. Most are uninhabited.
qs.sayAnswer: Sweden! It has more than 260,000 islands, and most are uninhabited.

title: WHICH
ONE IS
BIGGER?
hook: Which one is bigger? Maps lie, so trust your gut. Five duels, three seconds each!

qs.q: Which is bigger: Texas or France?
qs.fact: Texas is about a quarter bigger than mainland France.
qs.sayAnswer: Texas! It is about a quarter bigger than mainland France.

qs.q: Which is bigger: Türkiye or Texas?
qs.say: Which is bigger: Turkey or Texas?
qs.fact: Türkiye beats Texas by an area the size of Austria.
qs.sayAnswer: Turkey! It beats Texas by an area the size of Austria.

qs.q: Which is the biggest: California, Japan or Germany?
qs.fact: California is bigger than both Japan and Germany.
qs.sayAnswer: California! It is bigger than both Japan and Germany.

qs.q: Which is bigger: Alaska or Mongolia?
qs.fact: Alaska alone is bigger than Iran, and twice the size of Texas.
qs.sayAnswer: Alaska! On its own, it is bigger than Iran, and more than twice the size of Texas.

qs.q: Which is bigger: Greenland or India?
qs.fact: Flat maps stretch Greenland. India is really 50% bigger.
qs.sayAnswer: India! Flat maps stretch Greenland. India is really fifty percent bigger.

title: TRUE
OR
FALSE?
hook: True or false? Five geography facts that fool almost everyone. Three seconds each!

qs.q: Istanbul is the capital of Türkiye.
qs.say: Istanbul is the capital of Turkey.
qs.fact: The capital is Ankara, and has been since 1923.
qs.sayAnswer: False! The capital is Ankara, and has been since 1923.

qs.q: Africa is bigger than China, India and the USA combined.
qs.say: Africa is bigger than China, India and the U.S.A. combined.
qs.fact: Africa is 30 million km². Those three together are about 23 million.
qs.sayAnswer: True! Africa is thirty million square kilometers. Those three together are about twenty-three million.

qs.q: Mount Everest's summit is the farthest point from the centre of the Earth.
qs.say: Mount Everest's summit is the farthest point from the center of the Earth.
qs.fact: That is Chimborazo in Ecuador, because the Earth bulges at the equator.
qs.sayAnswer: False! That is Chimborazo in Ecuador, because the Earth bulges at the equator.

qs.q: Alaska is both the westernmost and the easternmost US state.
qs.say: Alaska is both the westernmost and the easternmost U.S. state.
qs.fact: Its Aleutian Islands cross the 180° line into the Eastern Hemisphere.
qs.sayAnswer: True! Its Aleutian Islands cross the 180 degree line into the Eastern Hemisphere.

qs.q: Australia is wider than the Moon.
qs.fact: Australia is about 4,000 km across. The Moon is 3,474 km wide.
qs.sayAnswer: True! Australia is about 4000 kilometers across. The Moon is only 3474 kilometers wide.

title: GUESS
THE
COUNTRY
hook: Can you name a country just from its shape? Five outlines, and the last one is tough!

qs.q: Which country is this?
qs.fact: Italy: the famous boot, with Sicily at its toe.
qs.sayAnswer: Italy! The famous boot, with Sicily at its toe.

qs.q: Which country is this?
qs.fact: Chile is over 4,000 km long but only about 180 km wide.
qs.sayAnswer: Chile! It is over 4000 kilometers long, but only about 180 wide.

qs.q: Which country is this?
qs.fact: India: home to more people than any other country.
qs.sayAnswer: India! Home to more people than any other country.

qs.q: Which country is this?
qs.fact: Japan is made up of more than 14,000 islands.
qs.sayAnswer: Japan! It is made up of more than 14,000 islands.

qs.q: Which country is this?
qs.fact: Türkiye: the bridge between Europe and Asia.
qs.sayAnswer: Turkey! The bridge between Europe and Asia.

title: HOW WELL
DO YOU KNOW
TÜRKİYE?
hook: How well do you know Turkey? Five questions, three seconds each. Number four trips up even locals!

qs.q: What is the capital of Türkiye?
qs.say: What is the capital of Turkey?
qs.fact: Ankara became the capital in 1923.
qs.sayAnswer: Ankara! It became the capital in 1923.

qs.q: Which is Türkiye's highest mountain?
qs.fact: Mount Ararat rises to 5,137 meters.
qs.sayAnswer: Mount Ararat! It rises to 5137 meters.

qs.q: Which is Türkiye's largest lake?
qs.fact: Lake Van is so big that locals call it a sea.
qs.sayAnswer: Lake Van! It is so big that locals call it a sea.

qs.q: How many provinces does Türkiye have?
qs.say: How many provinces does Turkey have?
qs.fact: 81 provinces, from Edirne in the west to Hakkâri in the east.
qs.sayAnswer: Eighty-one! From Edirne in the west, to Hakkari in the east.

qs.q: Which is Türkiye's largest province by area?
qs.say: Which is Turkey's largest province by area?
qs.fact: Konya is bigger than Belgium.
qs.sayAnswer: Konya! It is bigger than Belgium.
